x: The 1,500 metres was Simon's strong point and he scored well, finishing just behind Tony Pilcher and new member J.Heath. Ivan Beaumont leapt a tremendous 15'10" to win the long jump outright and also gained 2nd in the high jump but was it enough?
As shown on this issue's cover, David Bailey led home the field in the senior boys' sprint with some hot opposition breathing down his neck. New member James Heath took the colts' race.
